crossRefs.note: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.
For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.
Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; Neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob…
Pharaoh’s servants said to him, “How long will this man be a snare to us? Let the men go, that they may serve Yahweh…
Pharaoh rose up in the night, he, and all his servants, and all the Egyptians; and there was a great cry in Egypt, for…
Thus Yahweh saved Israel that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Israel saw the Egyptians dead on the seashore.
Israel saw the great work which Yahweh did to the Egyptians, and the people feared Yahweh; and they believed in Yahweh…
For it was of Yahweh to harden their hearts, to come against Israel in battle, that he might utterly destroy them, that…
For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to utterly kill and destroy them.…
When Judah came to the place overlooking the wilderness, they looked at the multitude; and behold, they were dead…
Behold, Yahweh makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.
For Yahweh is enraged against all the nations, and angry with all their armies. He has utterly destroyed them. He has…

translations.web: Come, see Yahweh’s works, what desolations he has made in the earth.
translations.bsb: Come, see the works of the LORD, who brings devastation upon the earth.
translations.kjv: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.
translations.asv: Come, behold the works of Jehovah, What desolations he hath made in the earth.
